| Booking | Passengers | Cabin | New flight |
|---|---|---|---|
| HZ4K7Q | Jan, Maja, Luka Horvat | Economy | ZX 404 (2026-11-03 07:00) |
| RS2M9D | Elena and Marco Rossi | Business | ZX 406 (2026-11-03 10:00) |
| NV8P2L | Anna Novak | Economy | ZX 402 (2026-11-02 18:00) |
| BG5J3R | Tom Berger | Economy | ZX 402 (2026-11-02 18:00) |
| LD9C6W | Sara Lind | Business | ZX 402 (2026-11-02 18:00) |

The Horvat family could not fit on ZX 402 because it had only 2 free economy seats, so they went to ZX 404. ZX 402 is now full in both cabins. The app confirmed each rebooking, and ZX 400's passenger list is now empty.
